title: When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly…
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly…
The sun is relentless. The land is dry. There is no storm forming in the distance.
Each beam rises against a sky that gives no evidence. Each strike of the tool echoes belief in something no one else can see.
I stay hidden among the wood stacks, dust clinging to my garments, watching obedience take shape before rain has ever fallen on the earth.

Faith doesn’t wait for proof.
It responds to promise.
And I can’t help but wonder…
What would it look like if I built with that kind of trust?
Where are you building in faith?
